Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketeer position at prado. With over two years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to prado's growth across global markets.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also applied structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits on my own project, mirook.com, to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. My familiarity with Google Ads, Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, combined with a data-driven mindset, aligns well with the requirements for this role.

I am particularly drawn to prado's innovative approach and family-driven culture. I am eager to bring my skills in campaign optimization, A/B testing, and e-commerce content management to your team. While my Dutch is at B1 level, I am actively improving it and am fluent in English.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to prado's digital marketing efforts. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketeer position at prado. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, I have been closely following prado's growth and am impressed by your innovative approach to home technology and your recent Henry Van de Velde Award. I am eager to contribute to your digital marketing efforts and help drive growth across e-commerce and brand level.

In my current role at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in digital marketing, focusing on on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and WordPress site management. I have successfully improved organic visibility for client websites by conducting keyword research, implementing technical SEO audits, and tracking performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. My familiarity with Google Ads and data-driven decision-making aligns well with the responsibilities of this role.

On my own project, mirook.com, I have applied structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and GEO/AEO techniques to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has allowed me to develop skills in content management, social media integration, and performance reporting, which are directly relevant to the digital marketeer role.

I am particularly interested in prado's focus on performance marketing, including paid advertising and influencer collaborations. While my direct experience with Meta Ads and TikTok Ads is limited, I am a quick learner and have a strong foundation in digital marketing principles. I am confident in my ability to quickly master new platforms and contribute to A/B testing and campaign optimization.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am comfortable working in a hybrid setup. I am fluent in English and Turkish, and my Dutch is at B1 level, with ongoing classes to improve. I am excited about the opportunity to work within a dedicated marketing team and contribute to prado's ambitious growth story.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
